Prices are what cricketwireless.com showed on 'checked'. autopay_price is the monthly price after the $5 AutoPay credit; first_month is what the customer pays at sale. Re-check against Cricket dealer materials before every price change goes live.

fine_print: Prices shown with $5/mo. AutoPay credit, which starts with the second month of service. Taxes and fees extra. Cricket may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy. Plans, pricing and features are set by Cricket Wireless and may change without notice. Ask in store for multi-line pricing.
